parts.text: {"deckName":"Cell Biology Basics","flashcards":[{"question":"What is photosynthesis?","answer":"Process plants use to convert light into energy"},{"question":"What do chloroplasts do?","answer":"They capture light energy"},{"question":"Why is chlorophyll important?","answer":"It absorbs light for photosynthesis"},{"question":"What gas do plants take in?","answer":"Carbon dioxide"},{"question":"What gas do plants release?","answer":"Oxygen"}]}
